stem.en: What do the young man in the Jataka tale, the Lijjat founders and Mohan Singh Oberoi have in common?

text.en: Each was born rich and used family money to start a business.
Each began with very little and grew one step at a time.
Each began with money from investors who owned the business.
Each worked alone and never needed help from other people.

explanation.en: The young man began with a dead mouse, the Lijjat founders with ₹80, and Oberoi as a clerk on ₹50 a month. Each grew step by step from that small start.

hints.en: Look at how each of the three stories begins.
